The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'he aids or protects that'.

Terms: ठक्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'killer' after the words 1. रक्षा and 2. यातू in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: यत्

The affix कन् comes after the word लोहित meaning a substance dyed red.

Terms: कन्
